bronze_ingestion_recommendations: SCHEMA: Preserve all columns as-is (string, int64, float64) for raw bronze layer; no transformation
NULLS: Flag sales_data rows with null transaction_id (8 rows) and null store_id (5 rows) during ingestion; consider dedicated 'null_flag' column
DATES: Store transaction_date as string in bronze; add parsing logic and error tracking in Silver layer; separate malformed date records
QUANTITY: Preserve negative quantities in bronze; add transaction_type classifier in Silver (SALE/RETURN) based on quantity sign
PRICE: Store unit_price and total_amount as-is; flag rows with unit_price < $1.00 or > $5000 as potential data entry errors for audit in Silver
CATEGORIES: Capture category mismatch between sales_data and products table in metadata; recommend manual reconciliation before Gold
REFERENTIAL INTEGRITY: For Silver/Gold layers, implement left outer join on store_id (retain nulls) and inner join on product_id; log unmatched store_ids
IDEMPOTENCY: Use transaction_id (accounting for nulls) + store_id + product_id + transaction_date as natural key candidate (with caution); consider composite key strategy due to nulls
